privacy.metaDescription: Learn how Toolii collects, uses, and protects your data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We only process your information to the extent necessary to provide our services.
privacy.summary: Toolii provides online image and PDF processing services. Files you upload are used solely to fulfill your processing requests and are automatically cleaned up according to system retention policies. We do not use your files for advertising or unrelated purposes.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: Account information: When you sign up and log in, we store your email address, encrypted password, and basic account status. If you use Google Sign-In, we store your OAuth identifier.
Usage information: This includes tool type, processing time, file size, error logs, etc., used for troubleshooting and service optimization.
Payment and credits information: Redemption codes, balance changes, and sharing records are kept for auditing and risk control.
Basic logs: IP address, User-Agent, request time, and path are automatically collected by the server, used solely for security and troubleshooting, and automatically deleted after 90 days.

sections.title: 2. File Processing & Storage
paragraphs: Uploaded files are stored in a temporary directory and automatically cleaned up by scheduled background tasks.
Download links use signed URLs with expiration times and become inaccessible after they expire.
bullets: Default file retention period: 24 hours
Visa package user file retention: 30 days (users can manually delete earlier)
Default download link validity: 1 hour
Expired files are cleaned up in batch by background tasks
File size limits: Images 20MB / PDFs 50MB

sections.title: 3. Face Detection Technology
paragraphs: The ID photo processing feature uses face detection technology (MediaPipe Face Detection) for compliance checks (such as frontal face detection, closed eyes/open mouth detection) and crop positioning (head proportion, eye position).

Face detection data (facial landmark coordinates, etc.) exists only in memory during processing and is released immediately upon completion. Our database and file system do not store any facial landmarks, feature vectors, or derived biometric data.
This technology is not used for identity recognition, face comparison, face search, or any identity-related purpose.

sections.title: 4. How We Use Your Information
bullets: Provide core features including ID photos, image tools, and PDF tools
Ensure account security, balance consistency, and transaction traceability
Perform performance optimization, error monitoring, and abuse prevention

sections.title: 5. Cookies & Local Storage
paragraphs: We use local storage to maintain login tokens, cookie consent status, and other essential information to ensure a stable experience across browsers.
You can choose to accept or reject non-essential analytics in the initial consent prompt. You can also change your preferences at any time via the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: If you use Google Sign-In, authentication follows Google's authorization flow.
If Google Analytics is enabled, analytics scripts are only loaded after you explicitly consent. Analytics data retention follows Google Analytics default settings.

sections.title: 7. Data Security
bullets: Full-site HTTPS encrypted transport
Passwords stored using bcrypt hashing, never in plaintext
Redemption codes stored as hash values, verified by hash comparison
Upload directory permissions minimized, accessible only by the application process
Logs do not record request body content, only necessary request metadata

sections.title: 8. Your Rights
bullets: View and correct your account information
Request deletion of your account and related personal data (all associated data cleared within 30 days of deletion)
Withdraw consent for non-essential analytics
For any privacy-related questions, contact us at contact@toolii.cc

terms.metaDescription: Read Toolii's terms of service and liability boundaries.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: By using Toolii, you agree to the following terms.
terms.summary: Toolii provides online file processing services for individual users. Please ensure the content you upload is lawful and that you have the right to process it. We strive to maintain service stability but cannot guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation in all circumstances.

sections.title: 1. Scope of Services
paragraphs: Current services include ID photo processing, image tools, PDF tools, and the Credits system.
We may adjust features, parameter limits, and pricing based on product development.

sections.title: 2. User Responsibilities
bullets: Only upload files you have the right to process
Do not upload illegal, infringing, or malicious content
Do not abuse APIs through scripts, bypass rate limits, or attack the system
Comply with file size limits: Images 20MB / PDFs 50MB

sections.title: 3. Credits & Redemption Code Rules
paragraphs: Once redeemed, a code is bound to the account and cannot be reused.
Exporting watermark-free ID photos and print layouts will deduct credits according to the rules.
bullets: If your balance is insufficient, exports will be blocked with a top-up prompt
Unclaimed shared Credits will be automatically refunded after expiration

sections.title: 4. Data Processing & File Retention
paragraphs: Uploaded files are retained for 24 hours by default before automatic deletion. Visa package users' files are retained for 30 days.
Temporary data generated during processing (such as face detection coordinates) exists only in memory and is not persisted.

sections.title: 5. Availability & Disclaimer
paragraphs: We do not guarantee that processing results will meet all official acceptance standards. Please verify before submission.
To the extent permitted by law, Toolii shall not be liable for indirect losses or lost profits.

sections.title: 6. Account Termination
paragraphs: You may request account deletion at any time. After deletion, all associated personal information and files will be cleared within 30 days.
If a user violates these terms, we reserve the right to suspend or terminate their account access.

sections.title: 7. Changes to Terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms and mark the latest date on the page. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
